text:
Fukuoka might be the easiest landing in Japan: the subway station is inside the domestic terminal and Hakata is 5 minutes away. So where should you sleep: Hakata, Tenjin or Nakasu? 👇

🎯 Bet you can guess which one we'd pick for a first trip. Check here 👉 https://japanbystation.com/fukuoka-where-to-stay-first-trip

We checked every travel time against Fukuoka City's own tourism site before writing this.

🏨 THE THREE BASES

🚄 Hakata. Kyushu's biggest station, with the shinkansen downstairs and the airport 5 minutes away. Quiet temple streets hide behind the office towers, and Sumiyoshi Shrine is about a 10-minute walk.

🛍️ Tenjin. Downtown Kyushu: department stores, the underground Tenjin Chikagai mall, and Nishitetsu trains straight to Dazaifu. It's 11 minutes from the airport.

🏮 Nakasu-Kawabata. Right between the two, with the river yatai, Kushida Shrine and Hakata's oldest shopping arcade on your doorstep.

💭 OUR TAKE

Hakata for most first trips. And don't stress: Hakata to Tenjin is 6 minutes and ¥210 on the subway, so you can't really pick wrong.

🍜 AFTER DARK

About 100 yatai food stalls open around the city from about 6 pm. Most seat around ten people, so you end up shoulder to shoulder with strangers over ramen and yakitori. That's the bit people remember.

👉 Plus the market where Fukuoka's chefs shop for breakfast:
